context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 238 fully tested. Three new features: (1) InOfficeWidget on dashboard shows colleagues with active desk bookings today - renders only when bookings exist, (2) Privacy opt-out via /profile toggle 'hide-from-office-widget-toggle' - users can hide from the widget, (3) Floorplan picker on /resources?tab=floorplan - shows dropdown only when >1 floorplan exists. Backend endpoints: GET /api/resources-in-office, GET/PUT /api/users/me/privacy, GET /api/floorplans. Regression tests for Iter 236 (drag-drop move) and Iter 237 (privacy mask) also passed.
